# Make Good Happen

> Make Good Happen offers Leadership and Engagement support for charities. We give executive counsel to the people leading charities, and we help charities engage the outside world through fundraising, communications and advocacy. We run entire fundraising functions. We offer advice and strategic support to executive teams. We have the range from delivery to strategy. We are fun, friendly, honest and dedicated. We can be trusted with the most significant relationships an organisation holds.

## What we do

- **Leadership** (https://makegoodhappen.co.uk/leadership/): executive counsel for charity CEOs, founders and senior teams, including senior team strategy, structure and growth, leadership recruitment and independent thought.
- **Fundraising** (https://makegoodhappen.co.uk/fundraising/): strategy, consultancy and hands-on delivery for charities, including major donors and philanthropy, trusts and foundations, supporter giving, events, and interim and fractional fundraising.
- **Comms and advocacy** (https://makegoodhappen.co.uk/comms-and-advocacy/): getting your cause heard by supporters, the media and decision-makers, including supporter communications, messaging and positioning, advocacy and public affairs, and video and content strategy.

## How we work

More at https://makegoodhappen.co.uk/how-we-work/

- Strategy
- Consultancy
- Hands-on delivery
